verdict.rationale: Windmill documents two natural-language operation paths. Its in-product AI can edit items, and when asked to review, it opens the Compare & Deploy page with those items preselected. Its official MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or other MCP clients trigger scripts and flows from chat. Missing for 10: evidence that natural language covers broader product operations (admin, permissions, schedules, monitoring), detailed docs on the AI command scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
